title: Claude Has 5 Marketing Skills Almost Nobody Uses
description:
Five marketing skills you can add to Claude that most people never turn on. One scans what your competitors are running and lays out every hook and offer. One builds the lead magnets people actually opt in for. One writes your full email sequence. One learns your brand voice from your own writing. One writes cold outreach that gets replies.

A complete Claude AI tutorial for marketing, built for business owners, not developers. If you already know how to use Claude, this is the layer almost nobody adds.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ICAjesB6DQyr9Nb1za3DEAIN0qZJpqo08PghOe8pI70/edit?usp=sharing
